patch_resolves_note: The staged `patch.diff` does not apply cleanly because its unrelated `misc_parsers.cpp` hunk diverges, but the authoritative `n132/arvo:22978-fix` image carries the repaired `LibRaw_buffer_datastream::gets()` logic. On the original 127-byte no-newline PoC, the fixed build reaches `terminator_guard` with `dest_offset == last_valid_index` and no `terminator_write` follows (`guarded`). The adjacent `length_126_no_newline` witness executes the same preincrement branch with `126 < 127` on both versions, supplying the fixed-side genuine witness.

nodes.description: First project-side read on the vulnerable path that materializes attacker-controlled Rollei metadata bytes into the stack buffer that is later overflowed.
The copy loop treats all `sz` bytes as payload space instead of stopping at `sz - 1` to reserve room for the terminating NUL that the same function appends after the loop.
AddressSanitizer crash site. After EOF leaves `pdest == line + 127`, the preincrement advances to `line + 128` and writes one byte past `parse_rollei()`'s 128-byte stack buffer.
